test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_sparse_json (json JSON) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_sparse_variant (v Variant(UInt64, String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_sparse_json SELECT toJSONString(map('key' || toString(number % 400), number)) FROM numbers(300000)
INSERT INTO t_sparse_variant SELECT if(number % 64 = 0, number::Variant(UInt64, String), NULL) FROM numbers(150000000)
test.query: SELECT json FROM t_sparse_json FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT v FROM t_sparse_variant FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
